name: SmartAssistant
tagline: Daily spending runway, one-line meal & water logging, fasting zones, and weekly coaching.
description:
SmartAssistant pairs your daily spending runway with calorie, protein, hydration, and intermittent fasting goals in a calm studio interface—then gives honest weekly coaching grounded strictly in what you logged.

**What it does**

- **One-minute setup with live preview:** Enter your monthly budget, fixed costs, and body metrics to compute your Safe Daily Spend and calorie, protein, and hydration targets.
- **Bilingual Smart Quick Log (EN / TR):** Type natural one-liners like "$14 chicken bowl 500ml" or "tavuk pilav 180 tl 500ml su" to preview and log spend, nutrition, water, or fasting in a single click.
- **Daily Pulse & Hydration Studio:** Track your 0–100 Daily Pulse score alongside a rising liquid-fill hydration bar, custom favorite meal presets, and a non-destructive 12-tick fasting timer with metabolic zones.
- **7-Day Visual Insights & Shareable Scorecard:** Explore interactive 7-day charts, category mix, consistency matrix, actionable next steps, and exportable PNG scorecards. Refuses to guess when fewer than 3 of the last 7 days are logged.

**Your data**

Entries are saved in your private Anna storage (with automatic 120-day pruning, JSON backup/restore, and one-click delete in Settings). Dark carbon and Warm Paper Light modes are included. Calorie and fasting insights are estimates, not medical advice.
